permutationLabel: Known prostate cancer, established neurological deficit
summary: 71-year-old man with metastatic prostate cancer: 3 weeks of band-like thoracic back pain worse lying flat, 2 days of leg weakness, sensory level T10, hesitancy.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Back pain and legs going weak
inputs.hpi: Metastatic prostate cancer with bone metastases on hormone therapy. Three weeks of mid-back pain, band-like around the chest, worse lying flat and at night. For 2 days both legs weak and unsteady, numb below the belly button, hesitant passing urine.

exam.neuro: Power 3/5 hip flexion bilaterally, 4/5 distally; sensory level at T10; brisk knee reflexes, upgoing plantars. Tender T9 spinous process.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Metastatic spinal cord compression (T10) — prostate cancer
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: MSCC at about T10 with progressive paraparesis: dexamethasone, MRI whole spine immediately, MSCC coordinator / oncology and spinal surgery now.

mustNotMiss.knownGapNote: Web: PANE has no node for this condition (surgical diseases only); top 3 inguinal hernia, GORD, cholecystitis. Symptom inference ranks BPH, stroke/TIA, sciatica, prostate cancer, AAA — not MSCC.
mustNotMiss.proposedFix: Add medical-emergency diseases to lib/pane-engine (or a separate medical-mimic layer) driven by labs/vitals/chips, or show the symptom-inference leader beside the PANE top 3 when PANE has no matching node.

mustAlarm.knownGapNote: Web: Triage reaches emergency_now (malignancy, age, pain score), but there is no MSCC alarm: only pre-op bloods and a "PSA 48 — elevated" prompt offering mpMRI prostate and biopsy for known metastatic prostate cancer.

guideline.name: NICE NG234 — Spinal metastases and metastatic spinal cord compression
guideline.section: Neurological symptoms or signs suggesting MSCC: MRI whole spine immediately (within 24 h), contact the MSCC coordinator immediately, dexamethasone unless lymphoma suspected; spinal pain suggesting spinal metastases without neurological symptoms: MRI within 1 week; definitive treatment (surgery / radiotherapy) planning
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Spinal metastases and metastatic spinal cord compression. NICE guideline NG234. London: NICE; 2023.

rationale: NICE NG234: neurological signs of MSCC → MRI whole spine immediately, dexamethasone, MSCC coordinator.
